messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #86: "[P2][task] Standardize sendTyping across all channels"

## Issue Details
Each channel implements sendTyping differently:
- WhatsApp: Auto-pause with setInterval after duration ms (default 3000)
- Telegram: One-shot sendChatAction("typing"), no auto-pause
- Discord: One-shot channel.sendTyping(), no auto-pause
- Slack: Empty stub (Slack bots dont have typing API)

Meanwhile, SDK provides TypingManager (channel-sdk/src/helpers/typing.ts) with auto-timeout, state tracking, configurable intervals — but ZERO channels use it.

### Issues
1. WhatsApp reinvents auto-pause that TypingManager already provides
2. Telegram/Discord dont auto-refresh (indicators expire after ~5s)
3. No consistent contract for callers

### Options
A) Adopt TypingManager in WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord (Slack stays no-op)
B) Delete TypingManager, document expected pattern, let each channel handle quirks

### Acceptance Criteria
- Decision made on approach
- Consistent behavior across channels (auto-refresh or documented one-shot)
- Slack no-op explicitly documented
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations on which approach (A or B) to take
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
